title: Senior Product Manager, Fraud Risk Platforms
jd_text: At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together. The Crown Is Yours As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll shape how DraftKings resolves risk cases while building smarter ways to prevent them from happening in the first place. You’ll lead the strategy and roadmap for risk case resolution, using automation, artificial intelligence, and customer self-service to scale our approach as we enter new markets and expand our offerings. Working across Risk Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Controls & Compliance, you’ll turn complex operational challenges into scalable systems that drive faster, more effective decisions. Your work will help trusted customers get resolved quickly while stopping bad actors with decisions we can confidently explain and defend. What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager Own and drive an outcome-based roadmap for risk case decisioning across AI-assisted review, case automation, self-service, and case management, aligning priorities to measurable operational and business goals. Partner closely with Risk Operations to understand how cases are worked, identify where agent time is spent, and use case volume, handle time, and other operational data to prioritize opportunities with the greatest impact. Define the right resolution path for different case types, determining where cases can be automated, supported by AI, resolved through customer self-service, or require human review. Shape the end-to-end case lifecycle, including case types, states, routing, prioritization, queues, resolution actions, closure criteria, and the evidence agents need to make informed decisions. Lead discovery and execution with Engineering, Data Science, Controls & Compliance, and cross-functional partners, translating complex needs into clear requirements, testable acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate automation rates, workload reduction, self-service containment, AI review quality, decision quality, and operational cost. Represent the case resolution experience in upstream decisions, making the operational impact of changes to orchestration, tooling, and risk models visible before those changes reach agent queues. Build auditability into automated and AI-assisted case decisions, partnering with Controls & Compliance to make sure decision rationale and supporting evidence meet applicable standards for areas such as anti-money laundering and Responsible Gaming. What you’ll bring A Bachelor’s Degree or any suitable combination of education, experience, and training, along with at least 7 years of experience in Product Management. Experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, or large-scale operations automation. Proven experience defining strategy, building roadmaps, and leading complex initiatives from discovery through delivery and iteration in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to prioritization, with experience defining success metrics, evaluating performance, and using insights to guide investment decisions. Experience working across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Operations, and other business teams to translate complex problems into clear requirements and scalable solutions. The ability to navigate ambiguity, balance long-term strategy with near-term operational impact, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across competing priorities. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional teams around decisions, priorities, and measurable outcomes. A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a focus on understanding users firsthand and turning operational challenges into intuitive, effective experiences. Familiarity with internal tools, customer-facing platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, risk operations, or foundational technology platforms is a plus. Experience in a regulated industry such as gaming, fintech, payments, or insurance is a plus. Join Our Team We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role. The US base salary range for this full-time position is 136,000.00 USD - 170,000.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. title: Site Logistics Operations Performance Leader
jd_text: At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet. Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place. About You and This Role Dow has an exciting opportunity for a Site Logistics Operations Performance Leader at our Texas Operations site in Freeport, Texas. In this role, you will provide leadership within a chemical manufacturing environment and support logistics operations responsible for the safe loading, unloading, storage, transfer, and movement of multiple chemical products. The successful candidate will possess a strong manufacturing operations background and a demonstrated ability to lead people, develop capability, and improve performance in a process-driven operating environment. You will partner closely with Production facilities, Maintenance, Engineering, and Technical resources to drive safe, reliable, and efficient site logistics operations. This role plays a critical part in ensuring operational excellence across process safety, environmental performance, productivity, reliability, and cost. The successful candidate will be a visible leader in the field, actively engaging with frontline personnel and coaching teams to strengthen operational discipline, improve management systems, reduce unplanned events, and deliver sustainable business results. Responsibilities Lead frontline operations performance across site logistics activities, including chemical loading, unloading, storage, transfer, and transportation support activities. Develop and maintain a strong safety culture through visible leadership, coaching, mentoring, and active engagement with operations personnel. Drive operational discipline and compliance with process safety, environmental, regulatory, and operating requirements. Partner with production facilities to safely and reliably execute logistics activities that support manufacturing operations. Lead and develop operators, shift leaders, and technical personnel to achieve safe, reliable, and efficient daily operations. Strengthen team capability through coaching, mentoring, performance feedback, and knowledge sharing. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve safety, reliability, productivity, and cost performance. Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks associated with hazardous chemical handling and facility operations. Improve management systems, work processes, operating procedures, and operational standards to drive sustainable performance. Prioritize team resources and improvement efforts to maximize value creation and eliminate non-value-added work. Ensure effective corrective actions are implemented from self-assessments, audits, Root Cause Investigations (RCIs), KPI performance gaps, and operational learning events. Champion operational excellence through robust use of data, metrics, problem-solving tools, and risk-based decision making. Serve as, or develop the capability to serve as, the Facility Work Group Leader delegate. Partner with engineering, maintenance, production, and EH&S personnel to continuously improve operational performance. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline, OR relevant military experience at or above a U.S. E-5 or Canadian Petty Officer 2nd Class/Sergeant ranking. A minimum of 5 years of manufacturing/operations experience in a chemical, petrochemical, refining, energy, industrial manufacturing, or similarly high-hazard operating environment. Understanding of process safety, operational discipline, risk management, and continuous improvement principles. Experience working in environments involving hazardous materials, hazardous energy sources, or complex industrial processes. A minimum requirement for this U.S.-based position is the ability to work legally in the United States. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of U.S. permanent residency (green card) process. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience within chemical manufacturing, petrochemical manufacturing, refining, industrial gases, terminals, marine operations, bulk liquid handling, or industrial logistics operations. Experience leading shift teams, work groups, production units, logistics operations teams, or manufacturing organizations. Knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM), Management of Change (MOC), Safe Work Processes, Root Cause Investigation (RCI), and risk assessment methodologies. Experience with production operations, maintenance, reliability, or operational excellence programs. Experience leading cultural transformation, capability-building, or operational improvement initiatives. Skills Operations Leadership: Builds highly engaged teams and consistently delivers safe, reliable, and productive operational performance through effective leadership and coaching. Process Safety and Risk Management: Understands and actively manages the risks associated with hazardous chemical operations, ensuring adherence to process safety and operational discipline requirements. Manufacturing Excellence: Applies operational management systems, performance metrics, and continuous improvement principles to drive sustainable operational results. Coaching and Development: Develops frontline personnel, operations leaders, and technical resources through mentoring, feedback, and capability building. Problem Solving: Effectively identifies root causes, addresses performance gaps, and implements sustainable corrective actions using data-driven decision making. Collaboration and Influence: Effectively influences and collaborates across multiple functions and organizational levels, building alignment among operations, engineering, maintenance, supply chain, and business teams to achieve common goals. Additional Information This position does not offer relocation assista nce. Benefits – What Dow offers you We invest in you. Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing. Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee: Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location). Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match. Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. Competitive yearly vacation allowance. Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. Additionally, some of our locations might offer: Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location) Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location) Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location) Join our team, we can make a difference together. Our global breadth, asset integration and scale, focused innovation, leading business positions and commitment to sustainability enable us to achieve profitable growth and help deliver a sustainable future. title: Inventory Specialist | Day & Night Shift | $30.00hr
jd_text: Power your Thirst for More at DrinkPAK, where we revolutionize beverage manufacturing, driven by automation and sustainability. Together, through grit and innovation, we break new ground in record time by acquiring the most advanced technology and attracting the brightest talent. Our explosive growth and journey through uncharted territories offers unique career opportunities enabling passionate individuals to reach their full potential. To support our teams, we offer enriching lifestyle accounts, comprehensive benefits, formal development programs, and an energizing environment. Drive your success at DrinkPAK, where we refresh, hydrate and nourish the world and our employees alike. Base Hourly: $30hr ($2hr Shift Differential on Night Shift) SHIFT: Must be willing to work night shift; 12 hours per day, 2/2/3 Schedule POSITION DESCRIPTION : This position is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and visibility of inventory within the facility. This role supports daily warehouse and production operations by verifying inbound and outbound materials, reconciling physical counts with system records, and identifying and resolving inventory discrepancies. The position requires strong attention to detail, knowledge of inventory systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally with warehouse, Kitting, Batching, production, and quality teams. ​ BENEFITS: The well-being of our team members is critically important to us. As part of this commitment, we offer: 100% PPO medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees, 50% for their dependents, paid by the Company A cell phone stipend 401(k) match program, pet insurance, life insurance, and more LOCATION: The position is based at DrinkPAK’s Texas Beverage Manufacturing Facility in Fort Worth, Texas. RESPONSIBILITIES Inspect and verify quality of all inbounds received by warehouse team, and report discrepancies. Manage real-time inventory transactions in our system. Execute daily, monthly, and quarterly inventory audits and cycle counts. Navigate company systems to track and confirm all inbound/outbound inventory. Process recycling and destruction loads systematically. Verify Proof of Delivery (POD) to ensure accurate inventory records. Maintain stock of finished goods, raw materials, and components per guidelines. Coordinate with receiving, production, and supply chain teams to ensure accuracy. Perform systematic material movements (Receiving → Inventory/WIP/Non-Conforming). Work with cross every department to ensure that we provide the inventory support needed. Closing FG jobs. Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, report findings. Identify expired or slow-moving inventory (SLOB) for disposition. Maintain proper product rotation (FIFO/FEFO compliance). Support special inventory projects as assigned. Ensure compliance with GMPs, safety standards, and company policies. Establishes and maintains high standards for quality, housekeeping and productivity Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of the job Interacts and maintains positive relationships with all levels of leadership Accomplishes special Inventory projects and other assignments/duties as required by management. Compliant to all safety rules and regulations, GMP’s and all Drink Pak’s policies and procedures. Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without prior notice. ​ QUALIFICATIONS High School Diploma or equivalent; Associate degree preferred. Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in Field or similar manufacturing / warehouse environment; 4+ years preferred; strong Inventory background and warehouse environment preferred. Forklift Certification preferred Bilingual (English & Spanish) preferred Strong project management, time management, organization, and communication skills Detail oriented and ability to problem solve and cross check documentation ABOUT DRINKPAK DrinkPAK is the premiere manufacturer of canned beverages in North America. As producers of the largest and fastest-growing alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in the world, DrinkPAK provides full-service support for procurement, batching, processing, filling, packaging, warehousing, and distribution. Founded in 2020, DrinkPAK has revolutionized canned beverage manufacturing by offering extreme capacity and format flexibility through cutting-edge technology and a commitment to the best talent in the industry. For more information, visit www.drinkpak.com. OUR VALUES Our company’s culture is guided by our shared values of Speed, Intensity, and Purpose. These values are demonstrated in the following ways among our Managers and above: Speed: Promptly identify and address potential issues or opportunities and be proactive in seeking solutions. Quickly consider the available information and weigh the risks and benefits to avoid unnecessary delays. Intensity: Embrace a growth mindset and recover from failures quickly, using them as opportunities to learn and improve. Focus on achieving measurable results and delivering value to the organization. Purpose: Set a positive example by demonstrating a strong work ethic, professionalism, and a commitment to our values. Create an environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued by encouraging cross-functional collaboration and knowledge sharing among team members. WORKING CONDITIONS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand walk, talk, hear, see, reach, bend, reach with arms and hands, stoop, squat, work onsite, be in-person daily and via video conferencing (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, etc.), and telephonically. The employee is frequently required to lift up to 50lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

This role partners closely with business owners, product, data, and engineering teams to document current-state systems and design scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-based solutions. This position focuses on emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, and machine learning, and guides solutions from research and analysis through architecture, delivery support, and operational readiness. What you will do: Lead discovery with business and technology partners to understand objectives, constraints, current-state systems, and integration points. Document current-state architecture and define target-state designs including system context diagrams, component designs, integration patterns, and data flows. Design and modernize applications into cloud-compatible or cloud-native architectures using microservices, serverless, and event-driven patterns where appropriate. Create strategies, roadmaps, and migration designs for transitioning applications and data workloads to cloud platforms. Design AI and ML-enabled solutions, including model integration into products and business processes, and patterns for scalable inference and low-latency serving where needed. Design Generative AI solution patterns, such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and API integration, prompt and context management, and evaluation approaches. Define reference architectures for AI platforms and enabling capabilities, such as data pipelines, feature and embedding generation, vector storage, model endpoints, and integration with enterprise APIs. Establish best practices for MLOps and AI operations, including model versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, incident response, and cost management. Incorporate security-by-design practices into architectures, including identity and access controls, encryption, secrets management, secure networking, and audit logging. Partner with governance and risk stakeholders to ensure responsible AI considerations are incorporated, including privacy, explainability, safety, compliance, and model risk controls as applicable. Drive alignment and adoption of proposed solutions by clearly communicating tradeoffs, risks, and value and obtaining stakeholder alignment and governance approvals. Selling means internal alignment and decision support, not external pre-sales. Support teams responsible for testing and validation and help triage and resolve design-related issues found during development, UAT, or production. Perform other duties as assigned What you will bring: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Business, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in agile software delivery environments with increasing architecture and design responsibility. Demonstrated experience designing distributed systems using microservices and or serverless patterns. Experience designing and integrating AI and ML capabilities into applications, including model serving considerations and data dependencies. Experience with one or more languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Scala. Experience with data persistence technologies across SQL and NoSQL. Experience with at least one major cloud provider, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and core cloud design patterns. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, including automated testing and deployment automation. Strong communication skills and ability to translate business needs into clear technical direction. What will set you apart: Hands-on experience with GenAI and LLM solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, evaluation, and production monitoring. Experience with AI and ML platforms or services, such as AWS SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI. title: Regional Director
jd_text: Job Description The Regional Director, Store Operations is responsible for leading a high-performing team of District Managers to drive operational excellence, profitable sales growth, talent development, and exceptional customer experiences across an assigned region. This role provides leadership and accountability for the financial, operational, merchandising, and people performance of all stores within the region. Reporting directly to the Zone Vice President, the Regional Director serves as the senior operational leader for the region, translating zone strategy into execution through a team of District Managers. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Asset Protection, Real Estate, Store Support Center teams, and other cross-functional partners to drive operational consistency, profitable growth, and talent development while ensuring Dollar Tree standards are consistently executed across the region. Principal Duties & Responsibilities Operational Leadership & Execution Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of District Managers responsible for achieving sales, profitability, operational, and customer service objectives. Execute zone priorities and strategic initiatives while ensuring consistent execution across all stores within the region. Drive consistent execution of company programs, operational initiatives, merchandising standards, and store processes. Conduct regular business reviews to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and implement action plans to improve results. Ensure stores maintain high standards of presentation, merchandising, inventory management, signage, and operational excellence. Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement throughout the region. Provide regular updates and business insights to the Zone Vice President regarding sales performance, operational opportunities, talent needs, and market conditions. Financial Management & Business Performance Maintain full P&L accountability for the assigned region, including sales, payroll, expenses, shrink, and profitability. Analyze key business metrics and company reporting to identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps. Develop and execute strategies to drive profitable sales growth while effectively managing expenses and operating costs. Ensure District Managers effectively utilize reporting and analytics to identify business outliers and improve store performance. Build financial acumen within the field leadership team through coaching, business reviews, and performance management. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership Recruit, develop, and retain top talent at all levels within the region. Create succession plans and leadership development strategies to build a strong pipeline of future District Managers and Store Managers. Coach and mentor District Managers to strengthen leadership capabilities, operational expertise, and business acumen. Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, and organizational development initiatives. Facilitate leadership meetings, town halls, onboarding programs, and development sessions as needed to support business objectives. Merchandising & Customer Experience Partner with the Zone Vice President and Zone Operations Director to ensure effective execution of merchandising initiatives and sales-driving programs. Drive operational and merchandising consistency across all stores while maintaining Dollar Tree’s value, convenience, and discovery shopping experience. Ensure stores deliver a high level of customer service through strong leadership presence, associate engagement, and operational execution. Identify and communicate field opportunities that support sales growth, operational efficiencies, and customer satisfaction. Asset Protection, Compliance & Inventory Integrity Foster a strong shrink-awareness culture and ensure effective execution of asset protection programs across the region. Partner with Asset Protection and Risk Management teams to reduce loss, improve compliance, and protect company assets. Maintain accountability for inventory integrity, inventory controls, and operational compliance standards. Ensure stores operate in compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. Strategic Growth & Cross-Functional Partnership Support the Zone Vice President in executing strategic growth plans, market expansion initiatives, organizational development efforts, and operational priorities across the region. Partner with Real Estate teams to identify opportunities for new stores, relocations, expansions, and market growth. Collaborate with Store Support Center partners to ensure effective communication, issue resolution, and execution of company priorities. Serve as a key voice of the field by providing insights and recommendations that support continuous business improvement. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience. 5+ years of progressive multi-unit retail leadership experience in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. Proven track record of driving sales growth, operational excellence, and profitability across multiple locations. Demonstrated success leading, developing, and coaching field leadership teams. Strong financial acumen with experience managing P&L performance and business analytics. Experience leading through change and executing large-scale operational initiatives. Strong communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other business systems and reporting tools. Ability to travel extensively throughout the assigned region. Preferred Qualifications Discount retail, grocery, convenience, big box, or specialty retail experience preferred. Experience managing large geographic territories and complex multi-unit operations. Proven ability to build high-performing teams and develop future leaders. Strong understanding of merchandising, inventory management, asset protection, and workforce planning. Start Rate = $135,000-$160,000 based on experience plus bonus and equity. The company offers Health, Dental, & Vision, a flexible spending account, life and disability insurance benefits, a 401k plan, PTO, paid holidays annually, and an employee stock purchase plan. title: Senior Data Analyst - Dow Jones Energy Product Management
jd_text: Job Description: About the Team: Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition. Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets. About the Role: This is an exciting time to join our small but growing Commercial Product Management team where you will be supporting a number of key sectors including: Energy & Feedstocks, Coal, Metals and Mining, Renewables & Clean Energy and Chemicals. We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to support business performance, revenue management, customer analytics, sales operations, product strategy, and executive decision-making. The position requires a combination of advanced Excel, SQL, Python, business intelligence, financial analysis, data visualization, and strong business judgment. You will work across large and complex datasets to develop reporting, dashboards, analytical models, and actionable insights for product and leadership teams. You are comfortable working independently on ambiguous analytical problems, reconciling data from multiple sources, automating recurring processes, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also serve as a key analytical partner to the Product, Sales, Finance, Customer Care, Consulting, and leadership teams. You will report to the Vice President - Product Management. You Will: Commercial & Revenue Optimization: Own end-to-end reporting for the Book of Business (ACV, renewals, new business, win/loss), building bottoms-up financial models, scenario analyses, and churn diagnostics to drive pricing, budgeting, and revenue retention strategies Advanced Data Engineering & SQL: Query, transform, and aggregate complex datasets across multiple source systems using optimized SQL to resolve data discrepancies and ensure unified, cross-system reporting integrity Data Quality & Governance: Establish rigorous validation processes, data cleansing protocols, and BI/Looker Studio dashboards that deliver actionable visibility into product performance, sales activity, customer health, and financial KPIs for non-technical stakeholders Process Automation & AI dependencies Customer & Usage Behavioral Analytics: Synthesize product adoption, API/web activity, and usage data into customer health scores and engagement metrics that empower Sales and Account Management teams to mitigate churn Risk Product Portfolio Strategy: Conduct product performance and entitlement analyses to evaluate pricing packages, support new product launches, and inform portfolio optimization or sunsetting initiatives Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a strategic analytics partner across Sales, Finance, Product, and executive leadership, effectively communicating complex methodologies and managing ad-hoc analytical priorities to guide business decisions You Have: 3+ years’ professional experience in data analytics, commercial analytics, financial analysis, market research, or a related analytical role Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; including complex formulas, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, nested logic, and data manipulation, VBA, Excel Macros, or Power Query Experience with some or all of the following technologies: Python (particularly Pandas and data analysis/automation) BigQuery, Snowflake, SQL Server, jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>WHY JOIN ALO?</strong></span></p> <p>Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. title: NPI Supplier Engineer III
jd_text: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $96,000.00 - $132,000.00 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . Key Responsibilities Work with New Product Development teams to ensure the integrity and clarity of engineering drawing requirements and that all expectations are communicated effectively to supporting suppliers. Participation with New Product Introduction teams to ensure suppliers are involved in the development and review of specifications to promote design for manufacturability. Continuous involvement in the Supplier Selection Process to develop a supply base that provides competitive advantage in quality, value/cost, delivery and technology. Performing the supplier technical audit process and evaluating supplier performance and capability, drive continuous improvement opportunities at supplier. Performing quality problem resolutions and incident management, drive root cause and correction action. Evaluates technical requirements of new and existing products. Applies knowledge of qualified sources and products to recommend materials to Design Engineering, which would result in savings, lead time reductions, system improvements, increased life and/or mitigated risk. Assist in cost planning by monitoring key cost drivers, supply markets, to ensure a competitive advantage. Support product development and improvement teams by sourcing new technologies from qualified suppliers. Functional Knowledge Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus Presents NPI project and supplier engagement updates to business units and supplier quality organization management Able to build partnerships with suppliers and Applied Materials product development teams, seen as a key contributor and problem solver Business Expertise Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market Leadership Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements Problem Solving Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information Impact Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies Interpersonal Skills Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus Presents NPI project and supplier engagement updates to business units and supplier quality organization management Able to build partnerships with suppliers and Applied Materials product development teams, seen as a key contributor and problem solver Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Assignee / Regular Travel: Yes, 20% of the Time Relocation Eligible: No The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable. For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement. Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jd_text: Who We Are ABOUT ENOVIS™ Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com . What You'll Do Job Description: At Enovis™ we sweat the little things. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients, and we glory in the grind of scientific excellence — with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it. Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. As a key member of the Enabling Technologies Team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward through transforming patient care and creating better patient outcomes. Job Title: Engineering Manager, Sustaining- Enabling Technologies Reports To: Director, R&D Product Development Location: Austin, TX Business Unit Description: Enabling Technologies Job Title/High Level Position Summary: The Manager, Base Business directs the sustaining engineering activities for the Enabling Technologies business unit. In addition to managing product development resources, the Manager individually contributes to development efforts. This includes but is not limited to creating prototypes, testing, and documenting test results; scheduling, coordinating, and managing multiple projects; and communicating with vendors to ensure proper design transfer. The Manager will be responsible for products including mechanical surgical instrumentation, electronic hardware, and software used by electronic hardware. Key Responsibilities: Manage project prioritization and resource allocation Mentor direct reports by providing technical guidance, coaching, performance management, and professional development opportunities Participate in product development including concept, generation, decision matrices, prototype, manufacture, and associated metrics Provide expert product leadership for the development projects assigned; this includes an unrelenting attention to minimizing project delays and resource overages Creates product designs and documentation used to substantiate those devices (i.e. risk assessments, verification/validation activities, design review documentation, etc.) Develops detailed engineering drawings using 3-D Modeling to document designs and design changes (SolidWorks) Confers with cross-functional team to identify tasks and requirements (Product Development, Manufacturing Engineers, Quality Engineers, Marketing, Purchasing and Regulatory Affairs) Maintains all documentation necessary for a Design History File (DHF), including Design Input Documents, Design Validation Plans/Reports, Test Protocols/Reports, and Design Input/Output Matrix. Assist in the regulatory submission process(FDA 510k, EU MDR, TGA, PMDA) by providing official information for regulatory review Minimum Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline 8+ years of professional experience (6+ years with a Masters degree)in a regulated industry Experience in medical device product development Experience with enabling technology (pre operative planning, navigation, robotics) preferred. Familiarity with software development processes Prior experience applying mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis. Prior experience defining problems, collecting data, establishing facts, and drawing valid conclusions. Prior experience interpreting an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and dealing with several abstract and concrete variables. Must be experienced in MS Word, Excel and Project. Experience with 3D CAD packages (SolidWorks preferred) Working knowledge and requirements of ISO 13485 and 21CFR820. Travel Requirements: <5% of travel required Desired Characteristics: Previous experience managing engineers Previous experience developing orthopedic medical devices(either implant development or enabling technology used with orthopedic implants) Previous experience leading projects of moderate to large scope and complexity Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to the manufacturing environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to the office environment. Employee is expected to work in varying environments, including office setting, mechanical testing lab, and cadaver lab. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to sit and use hands to operate computer keyboard, and telephone. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. This position works in a typical office/manufacturing/warehouse environment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Perform job duties for 8 or more hours a day. “Creating better together”. It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale. We know that the power to create better – for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders – begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes. Watch this short video and discover what creating better together means to us at Enovis: Our Enovis Purpose, Values and Behaviors on Vimeo We offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Spending and Savings Accounts 401(k) Plan Vacation, Sick Leave, and Holidays Income Protection Plans Discounted Insurance Rates Legal Services EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Enovis provides equal employment opportunities based on merit, experience, and other work-related criteria without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, sex, age, pregnancy, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We also strive to provide reasonable accommodation to employees’ beliefs and practices that do not conflict with Enovis policies and applicable law. We value the unique contributions that every employee brings to their role with Enovis.

title: Blackstone Program Director for Educational Operations
jd_text: <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Make a difference with us! At Alliance Defending Freedom, we believe God has brought you here for His purpose—to stand for truth and defend the God-given right to live and speak it. Together, we protect religious freedom, free speech, the sanctity of life, marriage and family, and parental rights. Review our <a href="https://adflegal.org/about-us/careers/statement-of-faith/" target="_blank">Statement of Faith</a> to ensure we’re a fit for you.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif; color: rgb(35, 111, 161);"><strong><span style="color: rgb(0, 48, 87);">Locations:</span>&nbsp;</strong><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Lansdowne, VA / Dallas, TX</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif; color: rgb(0, 48, 87);"><strong>Team Overview</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">The Blackstone Program Director for Educational Operations is a dynamic leader responsible for helping the VP of Philosophy and Education plan and run the Blackstone Legal Fellowship’s flagship educational event, the summer program, as well as its alumni educational offerings. The role is integral to planning and executing on our educational events, and to ensuring that each interaction with the summer program and alumni educational offerings—whether for interns, Blackstone Fellows, ministry friends, faculty, or special guests—is impactful, memorable, and aligned with our mission.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif; color: rgb(0, 48, 87);"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Program Planning &amp; Execution:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Direct and strategically plan program-wide logistics, including venue selection, event- and project-planning timelines, program agendas, technology requirements, communications with faculty, interns, and Fellows, and on-site event management, ensuring each event runs smoothly and exceeds expectations.</span></li> <li style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Monitor and evaluate the success of the program, using feedback and data to continuously improve the quality and impact of the program.</span></li> <li style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Monitor weekly and monthly budget reports.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Team Leadership &amp; Collaboration:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Oversee the Program Coordinator, providing direction and mentorship.</span></li> <li style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Work closely with Blackstone Team members, internal teams (Events, Development, Creative,<em> </em>etc.), and vendors to deliver high-quality, well-run program events.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Stakeholder Engagement:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Foster strong relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring their experience at events is positive and reinforces their commitment to the program.</span></li> <li style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Craft clear, concise, and compelling messaging for various audiences.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif; color: rgb(0, 48, 87);"><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">Bachelor's Degree in education, business, management, or related field.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">5+ years of experience in program management, program leadership, or a related role, with a proven track record of leading large-scale projects and educational programs.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); The suite includes ICCP/SCADA, Energy Management System (EMS), Voltage and Transient Stability (VSAT/TSAT) systems, PMU System, Itron Load Forecasting System, Operator Training Simulator (OTS), Data Historian (PI), Network Model Management System (NMMS), Market Management System (MMS), Outage Scheduler (OS), Congestion Revenue Rights (CRR) System, Grid Planning systems, Resource Integration system and Control Room Situational Awareness tools. This role plans and executes system software upgrades, configurations, application software release installations, and performs non-functional testing of GMS systems and applications. This position maximizes system uptime and mitigates GMS system failures. This role will analyze user requirements, procedures, and problems to automate or improve systems. Reviews computer system capabilities, workflows, and scheduling limitations. Design systems solutions to help the organization operate more efficiently and effectively. Provides 24x7 technical support for GMS systems on a rotational basis. Responsible for the integration of GMS systems and applications, monitoring, and regular maintenance of the GMS systems’ environments and derived systems. Responsible for planning, deploying, and managing containerized GMS applications utilizing CI/CD integration tools. Preferred Skills Requirement Programming Languages/Packages/Scripting: C, C++, Java, Perl, Python, PL/SQL, Shell Scripting Operating System: Windows, Linux Database: Oracle, SQL Server Source Code Control Tools: Git, GitHub CI/CD Tools (Github, Jenkins, Ansible, Jfrog etc.) Change Management and Defect Tracking Tools – Jira, qTest etc. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Level 2 Analyst: Requires minimum 1 year job-related work experience in excess of degree requirements. title: Sr Workday Systems Analyst
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. Works on a small Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) team that is responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ERCOT’s ERP product suite, which includes Workday Human Capital Management (HCM), Workday Financial Management, Workday Adaptive Planning, Workday Prism Analytics, Cornerstone OnDemand Learning Management System (LMS), and other applications (Contract Lifecycle Management, Exiger, Blackline, SuccessFactors, DocuSign). Works on broad cross-module and cross-platform functional areas. At the P3 level, this role serves as the primary technical authority and architectural lead across the ERP product suite, drives complex cross-module and cross-platform initiatives end-to-end, owns the design integrity and operational stability of the platform, and mentors P1 and P2 analysts on the team. Responsible for partnering with business stakeholders to pursue opportunities for greater efficacy and efficiency as well as to identify and resolve system issues. Provides consultation and support to SMEs and end-users of the ERP products through analysis, development, configuration, testing, promotion through environments, and change management. JOB DUTIES Understands and applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT’s culture. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Impact extends across the ERP product suite and to multiple business functions; technical decisions made in this role set direction and standards for the broader IT ERP team. Provides day-to-day technical guidance, design review, and mentoring to P1 and P2 analysts on the team; coaches lower-level analysts through complex configuration, reporting, integration, and security work. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES Architecture and design leadership: Define and shape the overall functional and business process architecture across the ERP product suite ensuring efficient and accurate design and configuration of the delivered solution. Serve as the primary technical authority on cross-module and cross-platform design decisions, combining expert-level proficiency in Workday and senior-level proficiency in Cornerstone OnDemand with deep understanding of HR, Finance, and Learning process architecture; translate broad and ambiguous requirements into deliverables and partner with HR and Finance functional analysts to align process design across departments. Release, delivery, and change management: Lead Workday release checklist process and complex issue resolution and post-release stabilization. Partner with HR and Finance business owners on Kainos Smart Test execution; lead defect triage for cross-module and high-severity defects. Sponsor and present major and high-risk changes at Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings; review and endorse changes presented by junior analysts; serve as a primary CAB representative and ensure change management and SDLC principles are applied across the ERP product suite. Reporting and analytics: Architect and lead the design of the reporting and analytics layer across the ERP product suite, including Workday Report Writer (Advanced, Matrix, Composite, and Search reports), calculated fields, BIRT report design files (authored in Workday Studio for report layout and formatting), Workday Prism Analytics datasets and dashboards, and Cornerstone Reporting. Lead the design of complex multi-source, audit-grade, and executive-facing reports; review and approve reports built by junior analysts; prepare scheduled and ad-hoc reports; set standards for report writing, calculated field design, and data governance; provide SMEs and junior analysts with report writing guidance, instructions, and documentation. Ensure data accuracy, security, and data privacy standards are met through reviews, testing, change management, routine data audits, and validation. Workday Prism Analytics: Administer the Prism environment — dataset design, transformations, dashboards, Discovery Boards, & security to deliver advanced analytics and reporting across HR and Finance. Set standards for Prism dataset modeling, naming, and governance; review and approve Prism work performed by junior analysts; partner with HR and Finance business owners on Prism roadmap and use case prioritization. Create, maintain, and execute Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) integrations for inbound and outbound data movement across all Workday functional areas; provide expertise on EIBs built by SMEs and junior analysts. Security architecture and configuration: Define and govern the Workday and Cornerstone security model — security groups, domains, business process security policies, role-based access, and Cornerstone constraints / OU permissions — in compliance with ERCOT policies and procedures. Administer the segregation-of-duties (SoD) framework, drive SoD compliance and remediation, and approve security configuration changes at CAB; review security work performed by junior analysts. Configure and maintain Workday business processes, condition rules, and notifications across all functional areas; architect and lead complex business-process redesigns that span multiple functional areas and that touch security, integrations, and reporting. Assess and make recommendations on the feasibility of security, business process, and reporting changes and their impact on data accessibility, business processes, audit posture, and downstream systems. Audit and regulatory compliance: Ensure adherence to and provide response to audit and regulatory requirements — SOX-equivalent financial controls, NERC CIP, and internal / external audits — including SoD reviews, security audits, audit log analysis, and remediation planning. Lead Kainos Smart Audit monitoring and findings response for SoD conflicts, security group / domain permission anomalies, configuration change control, and sensitive-data access across Workday tenants; serve a primary IT-ERP audit liaison and communicate effectively with SMEs, executives and external auditors. Cornerstone LMS architecture and administration: Administer ERCOT’s Cornerstone OnDemand environment — organizational units (OUs), learning objects, curricula, certifications, dynamic learning assignments, SCORM / AICC / xAPI content loads, custom reports, and security. Serve as technical contact for Cornerstone; partner with the Learning function on roadmap and platform decisions. Production support, operations, and vendor management: Own the production support function for the ERP product suite, including triage and resolution of the most complex, cross-module, and high-severity incidents escalated from others; conduct root-cause analysis and drive corrective action. Monitor recurring processes and scheduled jobs; perform regular application, systems, and administration tasks. Own third-party vendor escalations for Workday, Cornerstone, Kainos, and other ERP products. Manage change requests, and major project tasks in Jira; review and prioritize the team’s ServiceNow ticket queue; set and maintain technical and procedural documentation standards in Confluence (runbooks, configuration notes, integration design notes, post-mortems, and architectural decision records) and govern shared files in SharePoint and OneDrive in accordance with ERCOT records-management and data-classification standards. Mentoring, standards, and cross-team engagement: Provide day-to-day thought leadership, technical mentoring, and design review for junior analysts on the team and for HR- and Finance functional analysts and testers. Establish and maintain standards, guidelines, security policies, and quality assurance procedures for the ERP product suite; contribute to technical standards review. Partner with IT (Infrastructure, Identity, Information Security, and Data) to address system, interface, data, and vendor issues; represent the ERP team in cross-IT design forums. Maintain presence in the Workday Community and Cornerstone Success Center; participate in regional user groups and conference sessions; cultivate external peer networks at other Workday customers to benchmark and share approaches. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Requires minimum 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements, including at least 3 years of hands-on Workday and/or Cornerstone OnDemand configuration, administration, or development experience, and at least 1 year of demonstrated leadership on complex cross-module or cross-platform ERP initiatives. Combination of training and experience in information technology and business operations to incorporate business systems analysis, process analysis, EIB integration development, BIRT report design, security architecture, audit support, vendor oversight, and technical communication skills effectively into the role to maintain a high functioning ERP system. title: Manager/Sr Manager Grid Implementation
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. Manages the day-to-day and strategic direction of the Grid Implementation team. Responsible for analysis of upcoming changes to the grid (energization of new loads, generation resources, and transmission equipment) in discrete stages over the next several seasons to identify potential reliability issues that may occur as these changes are implemented. Also responsible for the communication of those issues to impacted teams, and for the development of mitigations to ensure ongoing reliability. Responsible for the determination, development and review of thermal/cascading-related Generic Transmission Constraints (GTCs), Congestion Management Plans (CMPs), Remedial Action Schemes (RASs), and Extended Action Plans (EAPs). Serves as a subject matter expert (SME) for the planning and operation of the electric power system. Supervises analysis and system studies, ensures appropriate system modeling techniques are utilized; analyzes simulated or actual operating results; develops solutions to current or future system issues; develops tools and procedures; develops solutions to current or future system issues, and appropriately reports findings and recommendations. Serves as a mentor for junior staff. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES Manages the day-to-day and strategic direction of the Grid Implementation team. Serves as bridge between planning and operations horizon from a grid improvements perspective. Assesses where new transmission constraints may occur due to load growth, change in generation resources and impacts of incremental transmission upgrades over the next several seasons prior to changes occurring. Works with other internal groups to develop appropriate study cases and tools for the appropriate study timeframe. Communicates and coordinates with TDSPs to gather and share input information, identify issues and potential solutions. As needed, develop CMPs, voltage and thermal-related GTCs required to mitigate identified reliability issues. Coordinates with other teams to identify need and implement localized contracts for capacity to resolve transmission reliability issues where appropriate. Leads annual review of CMPs. Responsible for review and implementation of EAPs. Responsible for reviews of proposed and existing RASs. Responsible for development of operating plans to promote the reliable and efficient use of the transmission system, including development and review of CMPs, RASs, EAPs. Serves as a subject matter expert for system performance standards and strategy for the ERCOT System. Maintains compliance with NERC Standards, ERCOT Protocols, Operating Guides and other binding documents, as appropriate, and supports revision process for assigned sections. Develops and sustains a high-level understanding of the competitive energy markets. Coordinates closely with other teams across System Planning, Operations and Grid Integration. Represents ERCOT on various ERO and ERCOT committees, subcommittees, working groups, and task forces. Responsible for hiring, coaching, training, and performance management of staff. title: Senior Product Manager
jd_text: <p>Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API.&nbsp; Our white label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.</p> <p>As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.</p> <p>As a Senior Product Manager at Array you will be a foundational member of a team, building on the backbone of our products. You will be working directly with leadership to define product strategy internally and externally, strategizing from a technical standpoint, how to ensure our products continue to be successful and dynamic. We are particularly interested in optimizing and understanding consumer front end conversion rates. You will work alongside product managers, engineers, and operational teams while building products that internal and external customers love.</p> <p>Selected candidates will have the opportunity to participate in a month to month evaluation period, typically lasting between 3-6 months. During this period, you will be expected to work on complex tasks with some ambiguity, utilize AI tools to enhance efficiency, and collaborate with the CEO, demonstrate technical ability with AI and SQL/data analysis. During the evaluation period, we will determine whether to transition to full-time employment, extend the contract, or conclude the engagement.</p> <p><strong>You Will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and optimize the front-end experience of the product, with a focus on increasing conversion rates and user engagement.</li> <li>Drive improvements in user onboarding and application flows, ensuring the best possible experience for customers.</li> <li>Analyze user feedback and data to make informed decisions that enhance product performance and drive higher conversion.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between business needs, user expectations, and product goals.</li> <li>Develop and implement initiatives to improve customer acquisition and retention, focusing on organic growth and return on spend.</li> <li>Build a cohesive strategy to optimize the B2B2C product journey, maximizing the effectiveness of both business and consumer touchpoints.</li> <li>Partner with other Product Managers and engineering teams to develop a compelling vision, strategy, and roadmap.</li> <li>Work with product and engineering to clarify, triage, and prioritize bugs.</li> <li>Assess risk and come up with well thought out solutions to eliminate any roadblocks for the team in accomplishing tasks on the product roadmap.</li> <li>Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it's your default, not an afterthought.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in a technically focused product management role; experience building products that shipped to market.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong technical background: Computer Science or software engineering experience would be great; must have experience writing in SQL and synthesizing data on your own.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience managing a consumer-facing app or product, with a focus on front-end conversion rate optimization.</li> <li>Proven ability to grow key user metrics (e.g., users, monthly active users) through specific initiatives related to onboarding or user flow.</li> <li>Expertise in managing product experiences for D2C or B2B2C models, with a focus on improving user-facing interactions.</li> <li>Familiarity with identifying and addressing barriers to conversion and making data-driven decisions to boost performance.</li> <li>Ability to understand and navigate B2B2C complexities, balancing the needs of both business partners and end users.</li> <li>Strong understanding of consumer company metrics such as CAC, conversion rate, and ROI, with experience avoiding excessive reliance on paid ad spend.</li> <li>A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pay Transparency: </strong><strong><br></strong>$80/hr-$100/hr, 40 hours per week -- for the contract period.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Expected interviews:</strong> Recruiter conversation - Meet the Founder.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Array Offers All Full Time Employees the following Benefits and Perks (benefits start upon conversion to Full Time):</strong></p> <ul> <li>Full medical, dental, and vision, premiums covered at 100% for full-time employees and 70% for dependents</li> <li>Unlimited PTO and sick leave + 14 company holidays to encourage a healthy work-life blend</li> <li>100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents</li> <li>$1,000 desk setup subsidy to set-up your unique remote office&nbsp;</li> <li>$100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses</li> <li>Summer Fridays (half-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August</li> <li>Commuter benefits for those who choose to go into our New York City or San Francisco office space</li> </ul> <p><em>Not sure if you meet the Qualifications? We’d love to hear from you.</em></p> <p><em>We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace; we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Project Manager, AMI
jd_text: Job Description: Founded in 1904, ESAB Corporation is a premier narrowly diversified global leader in connected fabrication technology and gas control solutions. Our rich history of innovative products, workflow solutions, and business system, ESAB Business Excellence, enables our purpose of Shaping the World We Imagine ™. We’re looking to hire a talented Project Manager based in Denton, TX. Reporting to the AMI Global Sales Director, the Project Manager is responsible for providing leadership and direction to the ESAB capital equipment project management team responsible from quote to customer acceptance. Projects include new equipment, retrofits, and customer engineered solutions across the automated cutting and welding industry. Partner and collaborate across the ESAB organization with sales, product management, manufacturing, and field service teams to exceed customer expectations for delivery and product performance. Primary Duties Determine and define project scope and objectives while leading project team efforts across new equipment (automated welding, cutting, and orbital tig) and retrofits of cutting machines from quote to customer acceptance. Collaborate with various stakeholders to ensure strategy, adjustments, and progress for a clean project delivery. Partner with finance to prepare budget based on scope of work and resource requirements. Develop and manage a detailed project schedule and work plan to ensure adequate staffing and cost. Track project costs to meet time and budget. Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the organization focused on process discipline, collaboration, and business acumen. Develop and strengthen project management process, tools, and capabilities appropriate to varied project scale and complexity. Participate in project and install planning meetings to provide guidance to the teams and ensure open communication of challenges and solutions. Other duties as assigned or may be required to support business needs. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or related field. 5-8 years of project management or related experience. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred. Ability to partner with customers with clear communications and expectations management. Proven ability to organize and complete projects according to outlined scope, budget, and timeline. Proven ability to solve problems creatively. Experience seeing projects through the full life cycle. Excellent analytical skills. Strong interpersonal skills, written and verbal communication skills and extremely resourceful. Direct people management and experience working in a matrix environment. Demonstrated program and project management experience for portfolio of complex projects up to $30M. Proficient on office equipment and computers, including, but not limited to, Word, Outlook, Project, and Excel. Working Conditions Remains in a stationary position 50% of the time and involves additional physical demands such as ascending/descending stairs, walking stooping and standing. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment ‘PPE’ when working/visiting manufacturing and plant locations. Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery including but not limited to printer, tablets, cell phones. Moves transports, puts, or removes equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.; pushes, pulls products weighing up to 200 lbs. using provided safety tools. May be exposed to varying weather during travel. Travel approximately 15-25% to support customers and manufacturing facilities.
